membrane.tm_helix_extent_definition: 5th-95th percentile range of c-ring UniProt TM-segment CA projections on the normal (descriptive; not a hydrophobic thickness)
membrane.method: c-ring axis (normal of best-fit plane through the 8 c-subunit centroids; open data) - chosen after audit: UniProt subunit-a TM ranges include in-membrane horizontal helices that skewed the all-TM normal by 13° - organeller-shared/tools/rebuild_mol0001_cring.py (wraps membrane_orient.py)
membrane.side_method: marker subunit(s) ['P25705', 'P06576'] (UniProt topology insufficient: N=0, P=0); sign kept from the all-TM normal
membrane.reoriented: 2026-10-07 08:08 - previous OPM-based orientation replaced by the open UniProt-based method (done while the OPM licence looked unclear; OPM was later confirmed CC BY 3.0 and is kept as a QA reference); 2026-10-07 09:50 - normal changed from all-TM average to c-ring axis after the AGREE orientation audit (12.9° change; angle vs OPM 20.0° -> 15.4°). Review: organeller-shared/reviews/MOL-0001_orientation_audit.md
membrane.helix_axis_mean_deviation_note: mean angle of the 16 c-ring TM helices to the c-ring axis (outer helices ~8.7°, inner ~2.8°)
membrane.opm_note: OPM 8H9S: 1/2 bilayer thickness 12.9 Å (CC BY 3.0, Lomize et al. 2012), cross-check only

vertex_attributes._CHAIN: float index into mesh.extras.chains (auth_asym_id, description, UniProt)

instancing: one mesh per LOD (one primitive per material slot), suitable for InstancedMesh

build.L1: as L2 but resolution 20.0 Å, grid 4.0 Å, decimated to <= 4000 tris
build.L2: Gaussian density of heavy atoms (atomic weights), resolution 10.0 Å (sigma=0.225*res), grid 2.5 Å, iso-level enclosing mass x 1.21 Å^3/Da, marching cubes (scikit-image), quadric decimation to <= 20000 tris; slot/chain from nearest protein atom
build.L3: one low-poly sphere per heavy atom at element vdW radius (gemmi); icosphere(0)=20 tris/atom if atoms <= 50000, else octahedron=8 tris/atom; budget <= 1000000 tris; waters/H removed
build.validation: Khronos glTF-Validator (npm gltf-validator 2.0.0-dev.3.10): 0 errors, 0 warnings for L1/L2/L3
